name: Zephyr ST STM32U5G9J-DK2
description: The Zephyr RTOS is a open source, highly configurable, scalable, secure, modular and vendor neutral real time operating system. This STM32U5 series devboard is part of the family of ultra low power ST MCUs. It has a large amount of internal memory and the embedded Neo-Chrom GPU which accelerates LVGL rendering. With such a large internal SRAM, direct double buffering is possible at the great speed of internal SRAM.
shortDescription: Zephyr RTOS project for STM32U5G9J-DK2 with LVGL
getStartedInstructions:
1. Install Zephyr on your host machine: `https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/getting_started/index.html`.
2. Run `west build -pauto -bstm32u5g9j_dk2 application`.
3.  Run `west flash` for flashing.
4. Run `west debug` for debugging.
